lines.zh: 我迈着均匀的步子巡查
lines.en: I patrol with measured steps.

lines.zh: 四格半的影子压在田地里
lines.en: My long shadow lies across the fields.

lines.zh: 每走十步，我转头看一次
lines.en: Every ten steps I turn my head once.
Fine dust rises round my feet.
I walk the village road, avoiding the well.
My gears turn in a steady rhythm.

lines.zh: 我跨过篱笆，像跨过一道线
lines.en: I step over the fence like a line.

lines.zh: 草原上的草被我一压就倒
lines.en: The savanna grass bends under my step.

lines.zh: 我的长臂摆动的幅度很小
lines.en: My long arms swing only slightly.
At the snowline I slow down.

lines.zh: 这里的地面软，得看脚下
lines.en: Soft ground. I watch my footing.
Patrol continues on the same heading.
I stop at the crossroads and scan twice.
This single eye turns slowly.

lines.zh: 红缎带的编号刻在臂上
lines.en: The Red Ribbon serial is stamped on my arm.

lines.zh: 我在核对昨天的巡逻记录
lines.en: I'm checking yesterday's patrol log.
Water moving in the field. Not a threat.

lines.zh: 风从我的通风口穿过去
lines.en: Wind passes through my vents.
I have no need to sit.

lines.zh: 镜头蒙了灰，我吹了一下
lines.en: My lens is dusty; I blow it clear.
The village windows are all shut.
I raise a hand, then lower it.
That chimney smoke is movement.
Scanning. Nothing unusual.
I've memorised every fork on this road.
A cloud shadow slides over me.
Standby does not mean asleep.
My charge is still decent.

lines.zh: 有人在窗后看我，我不管
lines.en: Someone watches from a window. I ignore it.
Waiting for orders. Waiting for a target.

lines.zh: 你从屋檐下出来，我看见了
lines.en: You came out from the eaves. Seen.

lines.zh: 我低头，你得抬头才能对视
lines.en: I look down; you must look up.

lines.zh: 你的位置在红缎带的名单上
lines.en: Your position is on the Red Ribbon list.
Identification complete: not a villager.
I tilt my lens down to fit you in frame.

lines.zh: 你手里有铁，我感觉得到
lines.en: You carry iron. I can sense it.

lines.zh: 别挥手，那不构成友好信号
lines.en: Don't wave. That isn't a friendly signal.

lines.zh: 你的距离，刚好在警告线外
lines.en: Your distance sits just past the warning line.

lines.zh: 我第一次见你，但记录里有
lines.en: First sighting, but you're in the records.
Leave in three seconds and I won't follow.
You didn't retreat. That's your answer.

lines.zh: 开始交战的判定已就绪
lines.en: Combat criteria are satisfied.

lines.zh: 装甲板凹了，动作没问题
lines.en: A plate's dented. Movement's fine.
I step back twice and reset.
A small knock sounds inside me.
Sparks leak from a seam.
That hit broke my rhythm.
My lens wobbled for an instant.
Damage within acceptable range.

lines.zh: 我的铁壳很厚，你累了吗
lines.en: My shell is thick. Getting tired?

lines.zh: 重新评估你的威胁等级
lines.en: Re-evaluating your threat level.
Continue. I have margin left.
Scan complete: non-energy material.

lines.zh: 你举什么，对判定没影响
lines.en: What you hold changes nothing in the criteria.

lines.zh: 我不需要进食，也不口渴
lines.en: I need no food and feel no thirst.
Don't trade that for my route.
My redstone still has reserve.
The closer you get, the faster the criteria fill.

lines.zh: 这不是诱饵能解决的事
lines.en: This isn't something bait can settle.
I glance at it. Once.
Put it away before I step on it.
Carry on your way.

lines.zh: 你没有改变我任何参数
lines.en: You didn't change a single parameter.
I look down to see who hit me.

lines.zh: 我的腿很稳，地形不平也一样
lines.en: My legs hold steady even on uneven ground.
Step aside so I can resume patrol.
Collision logged. No damage.

lines.zh: 你的肩膀撞在我的膝上
lines.en: Your shoulder hit my knee.
I lift a foot and step around you.
Don't stand in the middle of my shadow.

lines.zh: 我的重量会把地面踩陷
lines.en: My weight dents the ground.
Make way, or be pushed aside.
Formation requires two units aligned.

lines.zh: 我的右侧空着，你可以站
lines.en: My right side is empty. You may stand there.

lines.zh: 我能替你挡住正面来的箭
lines.en: I can shield you from frontal arrows.
Your pace is uneven; I'll slow down.

lines.zh: 任务之外的事，我不擅长
lines.en: I'm not good at things outside the mission.

lines.zh: 但我可以一直站在这里
lines.en: But I can stand here indefinitely.

lines.zh: 红缎带给的程序里没有这个
lines.en: Red Ribbon didn't program this.
Come closer; the wind is at my back.
If you're cold, lean on my leg.
Walk with me. Don't fall behind.
I scan it, then pick it up.
Redstone reads clearly to me.
Iron ingot. Recoverable.
I pinch it up between my knuckles.
All of this goes on the register.
What you drop counts as mine.

lines.zh: 太小，我的手指不太灵活
lines.en: Too small. My fingers aren't nimble.
Into the compartment. It won't fall out.
More on the ground. Collecting it all.
Collection done. Route unchanged.
Criteria met. Pursuit begins.

lines.zh: 你在我的视野里停了太久
lines.en: You lingered in my view too long.
My long arm is already raised.
Close quarters is my strength.
You run for the village gate. It's closed.
Distance: three blocks. Closing.

lines.zh: 我不需要瞄准，够近就行
lines.en: I needn't aim. Close is enough.
You're logged as hostile.
Stop shouting. No one's coming.
Executing the clearance routine.
I hold two blocks of spacing.
I am waiting for you to come within four blocks.
My shadow is the marker.
You've raised your arm twice.
I wait for you to come within four.

lines.zh: 你靠墙走，我不喜欢这样
lines.en: You hug the wall. I dislike that.
Your rhythm broke. Good.
My joints are warmed up.
You're no longer crisp in my lens.
The next step is the strike.
My arm falls across; the wind is dull.

lines.zh: 这一拳砸在你的护甲上
lines.en: This fist lands on your armour.
I drive a knee at your waist.
The iron palm falls; you drop to a knee.
You're shoved into the fence.
I held back a third of the force.

lines.zh: 我的长臂让你退无可退
lines.en: My reach leaves you nowhere.
My joint locks and I push through.
Your weapon strikes sparks.
Clearance motion. Continuing.

lines.zh: 我出现在村外，正好背着光
lines.en: I appear outside the village, backlit.

lines.zh: 巡逻单元启动，编号已读
lines.en: Patrol unit online. Serial read.
Population density here is high.

lines.zh: 我从热带草原一路走来
lines.en: I've come all the way from the savanna.
Four and a half blocks tall; eaves reach my waist.

lines.zh: 红缎带的人会知道我到了
lines.en: Red Ribbon will know I've arrived.
I chose open ground to come down on.
The village dogs bark first.
Lens focuses. The image is clear.
Beginning patrol of this village.
Warning: activity inside the zone.
My shadow is long. Don't be afraid.

lines.zh: 外壳烧得发红，我抖了抖
lines.en: My shell glows red; I shake it off.

lines.zh: 我从高处坠下，砸出个坑
lines.en: I drop from height and make a crater.

lines.zh: 水涌进排气孔，我挣着上岸
lines.en: Water floods my exhaust; I struggle ashore.

lines.zh: 装甲碎了一块，飞得很远
lines.en: A chunk of armour flies far.

lines.zh: 箭插在镜头旁边，挡住了视线
lines.en: An arrow beside my lens blocks the view.

lines.zh: 这力量不遵循物理，难防
lines.en: That force ignores physics. Hard to guard.

lines.zh: 电量告急，动作开始变慢
lines.en: Power critical. Movement slowing.
Lightning punches through my shell.

lines.zh: 没有地面，我的坐标失去意义
lines.en: No ground. My coordinates mean nothing.
